space: Godot model space: +y up, the horse faces +z, +x is the horse's left; metres

size.note: Hands in the usual notation: 14.1 = 14 hands 1 inch (1 hand = 4 in = 0.1016 m).
size.type: stocky 1750s colonial saddle horse (Canadian / Chickasaw / Narragansett type)

turning.note: Every moving gait clip X has curved variants X_tl / X_tr baked on a circle of radius turn_radius (hooves planted along the arc, the body leaning in). Blend them with X by curvature: weight = yaw rate x turn_radius / speed (-1..1, + = left). The runtime yaw limit is speed / max(turn_radius_min[gait], speed^2 / a_lat).

clip_ground.note: The riding clips are saddle-relative and need no change. Ground-relative rider clips (mount, dismount) were fitted to a ground 1.37 m under the clip origin; on this horse the ground is attach_height under it, so shift their origin by mount_ground_offset (m, along the saddle frame's up axis) while they blend between ground and saddle.

mount.note: Actor_A mount-left fit (horse.md 1.7): rider starts on the ground 0.69 m out, 0.18 m forward, turned ~101 deg to face the flank. The dismount lands ~0.55 m out. The mount clip's origin must rise by attach_height (not 1.37 m); see clip_ground.

rig.note: body is the trunk control (not skinned). chest: T1-T9 (withers, the shoulder blades hang from it), back: T10-T18 (saddle), loin: L1-L3, loin_2: L4-L6, hips: sacrum and pelvis (turns about the lumbosacral joint). The shoulder blades turn about a point in their upper part (pivot_from_top of their length) and glide down the ribcage while their leg carries no weight.

jump.note: The root (CharacterBody) flies a ballistic arc from takeoff_time to landing_time (clip time); the clip's body height is relative to that lifted root. At playback rate r the launch speed is launch_speed_rate1 / r. clearance: highest rail per rate and the distance from the root at the jump start to the rail (best_x, and the window in which a 0.6 m rail clears).

materials.horse_coat: assets/horse/materials/horse_coat.gdshader: coat masks, normal, detail and flow textures (assets/horse/textures/horse_coat_*.png, baked by tools/horse/coat.py)
materials.horse_hair: assets/horse/materials/horse_hair.gdshader: hair cards (horse_hair_strands.png), alpha scissor, two-sided, anisotropic highlight along the strands
materials.horse_hoof: assets/horse/materials/horse_hoof.gdshader: horn with growth rings, light horn under the sock
materials.tack_cloth: Poly Haven poly_wool_herringbone (CC0) dyed madder red: wool saddle cloth
materials.tack_girth: Poly Haven hessian_230 (CC0): woven girth web

look.note: scripts/horse/horse_look.gd assigns these materials by the glTF material names and applies a coat variant (Horse.coat) through per-instance shader parameters.
look.texture_check_note: Blender (horse) space samples of the baked flow texture: uv (Blender, v up), rest position p, normal n and the 3D hair direction the texel encodes. tests/horse/test_horse.gd decodes the texel with Godot's tangent frame and compares (normal-map and flow conventions).

source_note: Procedural (generated). Gait timing from the Actor_B rider clips; no rider animation data is stored in the horse asset.
